name: Kumho Tire
verdict: Kumho Tire is a controlled subsidiary of Shenzhen-listed Qingdao Doublestar, which indirectly holds 45%; Qingdao Doublestar's controlling shareholder is Doublestar Group and its actual controller is the Qingdao city government's state-assets commission (Qingdao SASAC).
note: Sleeve partner of Jeonbuk Hyundai for 2026 (CEO Score Daily, 2026-03-03). Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposed 'serious' in the pull request for issue #533: a Chinese state body controls the sponsor (the link, claims kumho-tire-doublestar-control and qingdao-doublestar-sasac, each with a second publisher; owner chain kumho-tire, qingdao-doublestar, doublestar-group, qingdao-municipal-government, government-of-china), and China's record is on main (china-xinjiang-un-assessment). Korean creditor banks, among them Korea Development Bank (7.43%), hold about 14% (thebell, 2026-09-07). No `why` is written yet.
